menu_moment.moment: 막 부친 계란후라이를 밥 위에 올려 노른자를 터뜨리고, 한 숟갈 떠서 입에 넣기 직전까지 가져간 뒤 먹는 순간

visible_entities: fresh fried egg with runny yolk
Korean metal spoon when action requires it
dining_grammar: fried egg is already placed on top of rice before yolk-breaking begins
metal spoon may press, scoop and carry the egg-rice
no Japanese-style tableware or chopstick placement is introduced by default
no extra soup, seaweed garnish, side dishes or condiments appear unless explicitly added

depicted_state: fried egg is already on top of rice
proxy eater is visible but secondary to the bowl

depicted_action_phase.description: opening keyframe before any food contact

must_show: egg is visibly on top of rice
person is secondary to the bowl
must_not_show: extra meal entities not declared by meal context

observable_cues: thin browned edge on egg white
appetite.reader_proxy_value: the next action promises a visible texture change

copy_plan.copy: 흰자 끝은 살짝 바삭하고, 노른자는 아직 묽다.

depicted_state: egg remains on top of rice
metal spoon is physically pressing into the yolk
runny yolk is beginning to coat nearby rice

depicted_action_phase.description: the frame shows the actual yolk-breaking contact, not a before/after guess

steps.action: bring the spoon from rest/hand position to the yolk contact zone
press the spoon into the yolk while the egg remains on the rice

transition_from_previous.omission_justification: moving the utensil into position is routine; the meaningful transformation itself is shown.

slides.visual_delta_from_previous: person/context recedes; contact point and initial yolk spread dominate
must_show: egg is still positioned on rice
yolk break begins at the contact point
must_not_show: egg broken before being placed on rice

sensory_payload: runny yolk beginning to coat rice
observable_cues: yellow yolk spreads over a limited patch of white rice from the contact point
appetite.reader_proxy_value: the transformation creates the texture for the coming bite

depicted_state: a spoonful of yolk-coated rice has been scooped
the spoonful is held immediately in front of the mouth
there is no mouth contact yet
the bowl is already partial and has a visible scoop gap

depicted_action_phase.description: the exact keyframe is after scooping and raising, immediately before the spoonful enters the mouth

steps.action: scoop a portion of the yolk-coated rice onto the spoon
raise the loaded spoon toward the proxy eater's mouth

transition_from_previous.omission_justification: the scoop is physically routine and is explicitly recorded; this fixture reserves the frame for the unambiguous pre-bite keyframe.

slides.camera_relation: side-oblique pre-bite view with the spoonful clearly separated from the mouth
slides.visual_delta_from_previous: macro food contact becomes body-scale pre-ingestion
must_show: spoon is immediately before the mouth but has not entered it
bowl state is already partial after scooping
must_not_show: extra fingers or broken arm geometry

observable_cues: small coherent spoonful with visible yolk coating
appetite.reader_proxy_value: the reader sees exactly what will be eaten next without causal ambiguity

copy_plan.copy: 노른자 묻은 밥이 입안에서 금방 부드러워진다.

depicted_state: the spoonful shown in S03 has been eaten
the same partial bowl state remains
yolk streaks and the scoop gap remain visible

depicted_action_phase.description: the bite itself occurred between frames; this keyframe shows the unchanged bowl residue after ingestion

steps.action: move the spoonful through mouth contact and consume the bite

transition_from_previous.omission_justification: for this fixed four-frame architecture test, ingestion is causally obvious and does not change the already-scooped bowl pixels. In normal production, promote ingestion to its own frame whenever the bite/contact itself carries enough sensory or narrative value.

slides.visual_delta_from_previous: person disappears; the exact approved residue-food pixels become the sole focal mass
must_show: same partial-bowl food pixels/state as S03
yolk streaks remain where mixing/contact occurred
state is clearly later than S01

observable_cues: yellow coating and spoon-scoop gap remain visible
appetite.reader_proxy_value: the ending proves the bite occurred without an evaluative punchline

required_assets.description: proxy eater context pose; becomes the identity anchor only after composed S01 user pass
ceramic bowl, white rice, fried egg already on top, runny yolk intact
compound macro asset preserving hand + Korean metal spoon + bowl/egg contact at the exact yolk-breaking keyframe
partial bowl after scooping one spoonful; exact approved pixels intentionally reused in S03 and S04
same proxy-eater upper-body/hand identity + loaded spoon immediately before mouth contact; bowl remains a separate reusable FOOD_STATE layer

asset_dependency_dag.rule: independent foundation assets; PERSON waits for actual STYLE_REF_001 media binding
author only after required person/food anchors are QC-approved and hash-bound
author after the accepted break-state asset establishes food appearance/state continuity
author only after the user-validated S01 identity anchor exists and residue-food appearance is approved
